description: Narrow event hygiene correction for B.Y.O.GAMES LLC Commander Night rows: use the 4:00 PM doors/open-play time as the planning start while preserving 7:45 PM as the structured tournament/pod timing in notes.
author: Codex Project Steward

fields.details: Doors/open play begin at 4:00 PM for casual games, warm-ups, and free-play. The structured tournament/pod timing appears to be 7:45 PM; four players minimum are needed to run a pod, entry is $10, Bracket 3-4, no infinites, and Rule Zero is strongly encouraged before games.

operations.reason: For personal planning, the useful displayed start is when the player can arrive for casual/open-play activity. The prior 7:45 PM value is preserved in notes as the structured tournament/pod timing rather than used as the whole event's start.
